''Byens Hold'' (The City's Team) | short name = AGF | founded = {{Start date and age|df=yes|26|9|1880}} | ground = [[Vejlby Stadium|Ceres Park Vejlby]] (Temporary, pending construction of a new [[Aarhus Stadium]]) | capacity = 11,500 (3,400 seated){{cite news |last1=Nissen |first1=Søren Steen |title=Vejlby Stadion udvides |url=https://bold.dk/fodbold/nyheder/vejlby-stadion-udvides/ |access-date=11 May 2026 |work=Bold |date=25 May 2025 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260511172257/https://bold.dk/fodbold/nyheder/vejlby-stadion-udvides/ |archive-date=11 May 2026 |language=da |trans-title=Vejlby Stadium expanded}} | chairman = Jacob Nielsen | mgrtitle = Head coach | manager = [[Jakob Poulsen]] | league = [[Danish Superliga]] | season = [[2025–26 Danish Superliga|2025–26]] | position = [[Danish Superliga]], 1st of 12 (champions) | website = {{URL|https://agf.dk/|agf.dk}} | pattern_la1 = _aarhus2627h | pattern_b1 = _aarhus2627h | pattern_ra1 = _aarhus2627h | pattern_sh1 = | pattern_so1 = _whitetopl | leftarm1 = ffffff | body1 = ffffff | rightarm1 = ffffff | shorts1 = 191c51 | socks1 = 191c51 | pattern_la2 = _aarhus2627a | pattern_b2 = _aarhus2627a | pattern_ra2 = _aarhus2627a | pattern_sh2 = | pattern_so2 = _toponwhitel | leftarm2 = 191c51 | body2 = 191c51 | rightarm2 = 191c51 | shorts2 = ffffff | socks2 = 191c51 | current = 2026–27 Aarhus Gymnastikforening season }} '''Aarhus Gymnastikforening''' ({{IPA|da|ˈɒːˌhuˀs kymnaˈstikfʌˌe̝ˀne̝ŋ|lang}}, {{lit|Aarhus Gymnastic Union}}; commonly known as '''AGF''' {{IPA|da|æke̝ˀˈef|lang}}) is a professional [[sports club]] based in [[Aarhus]], [[Jutland]], Denmark. Founded in 1880, it is one of the oldest clubs in the country where [[gymnastics]] and fencing were featured as its main sports. However, AGF is mostly known for its [[Association football|football]] department, which was established in 1902. The club's first team plays in the [[Danish Superliga]], the top flight of the [[Danish football league system]]. AGF has won six [[Danish football champions|Danish Football Championships]] - most recently in the season of 2025–26 - and nine [[Danish Cup]]s. In 1961, AGF reached the quarter-finals of the [[1960–61 European Cup|European Cup]] where they were knocked out by later winners, [[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]]. In 1989, AGF again reached a European quarter-final, this time in the [[1988–89 European Cup Winners' Cup|European Cup Winners' Cup]], where they lost 1–0 on aggregate to later winners [[FC Barcelona]]. They won [[The Atlantic Cup (football)|the Atlantic Cup]] twice, in 2018 and 2020. Finally in 2026 the team won the Superliga making it their first 2000s Superliga title."}}
